top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionTable
top_extraction_candidates.why: 18 distinct table surfaces found (brief named 10; broader grep found 8 more), split roughly evenly between raw <table> and Nuxt UI <UTable>, with at least 3 different mobile strategies (horizontal-scroll, hidden-columns, cards), 3 independent hand-rolled sort-header implementations, 3 different server pagination response shapes, and 2 closed defects (stonx#208, #218/#219) caused directly by ad hoc pagination/search wiring

top_extraction_candidates.name: AppEmptyState convergence
top_extraction_candidates.why: already a single, heavily-adopted (46 consumers) local component nearly identical in shape to narduk-core's AppEmptyState -- the lowest-risk, highest-reuse win in the repo since stonx would only need to swap the import, not rewrite call sites

top_extraction_candidates.name: MetricCard/Metric/MetricGrid family
top_extraction_candidates.why: 46 combined consumer references across 3 small files is the second-highest reuse count measured in the repo after CommonEmptyState, and directly matches the KPI/stat-tile gap narduk-ui's NsReadoutTile targets

top_extraction_candidates.name: PageShell / AppHeader / AppFooter
top_extraction_candidates.why: CommonPageShell alone has 23 consumers (the single highest count found); combined with AppHeader/AppShell/AppFooter this is app-shell infrastructure stonx built from scratch with naming that mirrors narduk-core's Layer* components almost exactly, despite having zero narduk-core dependency

top_extraction_candidates.name: PaginationBar (with page-size picker)
top_extraction_candidates.why: only 1 direct consumer today, but it is the only pagination UI in the app with a page-size selector and distinct mobile/desktop layouts -- the 12 sites using bare UPagination lack page-size control entirely, so a shared component modeled on this one would be a net feature upgrade, not just a dedupe

notes: stonx has ZERO dependency on narduk-core, narduk-auth, narduk-ui, or narduk-mapkit-nuxt (confirmed via package.json and nuxt.config.ts); it only consumes narduk-charts (3 real usages: NardukCandleChart, NardukLineChart x2, NardukPieChart), narduk-analytics and narduk-seo (registered as Nuxt modules in nuxt.config.ts, no direct .vue component usage found). This means every layout-shell, empty-state, confirm-modal, page-header, and KPI-tile component in narduk-core was independently reinvented here under near-identical names (AppHeader/AppShell/AppFooter vs LayerAppHeader/LayerAppShell/LayerAppFooter; CommonEmptyState vs AppEmptyState; CommonConfirmModal vs AppConfirmModal) with no code sharing. Surprise: PR stonx#78 'Mobile Responsiveness Overhaul - No Horizontal Scrolling' merged, yet 8+ of the 18 table surveyed surfaces still use overflow-x-auto/min-w-[...] horizontal-scroll as their mobile strategy today -- the fix either didn't cover tables or the pattern crept back in later feature work. The repo's own file-size-budget eslint rule (180 target / 300 hard cap for components) is a direct, measurable pressure toward extracting a shared table: PositionTable.vue (434 loc) and WatchlistTable.vue (364 loc) both need an eslint-disable to exist as single files today.
